name: frozen-history-state-closed-loop-bridge
claim: Frozen history grounding improves pre-contact command-conditioned prediction under held-out controllers; available feedback may remove its additional action value.
unit_of_analysis: whole stored test history pair; controller, wait, cap and checkpoint seeds are dependent repeated measurements
datasets: round3 controlled-release transfer_v2 stored test histories
round4 frozen controller and converged RK4 execution

splits.name: controller-transfer
splits.leakage_check: unchanged checkpoint and source-data hashes; original 301x5 contact encoding cut only

baselines.name: classical
baselines.category: full measured-history integration with fitted parameters

baselines.name: reactive_005_and_030
baselines.category: round4 validation-selected gains; predeclared 0.05 and 0.30 N margins

metrics.name: precontact_120ms_force_RMSE
metrics.rationale: fixed known future command at 20 ms before recontact, shared-input diagnostic

metrics.name: history_initialization_cost_gain
metrics.rationale: snapshot minus history failure-penalized cost in the same controller

metrics.name: gap_contraction_time
metrics.rationale: first >=0 recontact time where mean force-RMSE gap stays within 0.02 N for at least 50 ms

metrics.name: completion_time_quality_peak_failures_action_difference
metrics.rationale: separate physical duration, achieved hold, peak and failure causes from penalty cost

ablations: seed-11 common-input observer with force innovation removed, diagnostic only; primary controllers retain all feedback
falsification_criteria: history has no precontact forecast advantage in the shared-input diagnostic
feedback reduces initialization differences before action consequences separate
gain remains below 50 ms and 2 percentage points success, with constraints nonworsening
integration requires retraining, a different task or a major controller rewrite: stop and document the gap
artifacts: minimal adapter and unchanged execution code

frozen_scope.state: two Maxwell internal deformations in metres; same ordering and fitted material constants as round3/round4
frozen_scope.encoding: one inference at the original in-contact cut; never re-encode detached or new-controller histories
frozen_scope.prefix: same 0.3 s release under original K=2200,D=45 using converged execution; measured-motion propagation and identical causal force correction for every predictive method
frozen_scope.covariance: same 1.5 mm initial standard deviation at encoding; carry posterior covariance through release into the fourth-round controller
frozen_scope.task: round4 4 mm compression held 200 ms, 4 s deadline then 350 ms release; 1 ms physics, 100 Hz sensing, 50 Hz control
frozen_scope.execution_metrics: fourth-round task metrics start after the common prefix; report its peak separately and an end-to-end force-limit failure so prefix violations are not hidden
frozen_scope.prediction: common fixed command probe is a diagnostic, not a substituted action task; no future measured motion or force enters forecasts
frozen_scope.statistics: pair-cluster bootstrap; average three frozen checkpoint seeds inside each pair before primary intervals; also report all seed results
frozen_scope.interpretation: existing history segment was generated with round3 discretization and is not regenerated; future execution switches to the verified reference from its stored physical endpoint
